messages:
maria-zhang: Heads up — hitting auth refresh 401s when running the new next-starter-wasm-kv sample on edge runtime. SDK v2.0.0, Next 13.4 edge. Reproducer: deploy to Vercel, make 100 rapid embed requests, ~5% return 401.
kevin-singh: @maria-zhang can you paste the dev console/logs? Is the token refresh hitting our refresh endpoint or the SDK auto refresh?
maria-zhang: It's using SDK auto-refresh. Logs show 'token expired' then a POST /api/auth/refresh succeeds but the subsequent inference request still 401. Stack: fetch wrapper -> SDK.generate.
olivia-park: We saw similar — edge fetch sometimes loses cookies/headers when using wasm KV cache for prefixes. There's a known race with credential forwarding. Filed a fix in SDK 2.1.3. Try pinning to that. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/compare/v2.0.0...v2.1.3 :eyes:
sam-garcia: Short workaround: ensure refresh happens synchronously before the queued batch. Example wrapper:

```
async function ensureToken() {
  if (isExpired(token)) {
    await fetch('/api/auth/refresh')
  }
}

export async function safeGenerate(req) {
  await ensureToken()
  return sdk.generate(req)
}
```

This reduces 401 spikes for me.
kevin-singh: also increase retry/backoff in edge runtime: set retries:3 and jittered backoff. Use the client option `auth: { mode: 'server-side-refresh' }` if you can move refresh to server.
maria-zhang: Will try `2.1.3` + synchronous refresh. One more question — does the wasm kv cache keep tokens? I thought it only caches prefixes.
olivia-park: KV cache is only for text prefixes/KV keys, not auth tokens. But some sample apps accidentally store whole request body with headers in cache by accident — check your cache key function.
ci-bot: Deploy succeeded — preview url: https://next-starter-wasm-kv.pr-78.redwood-inference.net :white_check_mark:
maria-zhang: Thanks! after patching to 2.1.3 + wrapper the 401s dropped to ~0.4% on load test. Filing a small doc PR to note the edge caveats.
sam-garcia: If anyone wants, I can add a test harness / small Playwright test to catch auth racing on CI.
kevin-singh: please do. Also add an entry in the sample README about pinning SDK and auth patterns. :thumbsup:
maria-zhang: Assigned to sam — will open follow-up issues with logs.
